{{Quote|Down in front!''"<br />"''Who said that?''"<br />"''I did, you big freak. You're blocking everyone's view.|Unidentified old man and the armored man|<ref name="Invasion: Rescues 1">[[Invasion: Rescues 1|''Invasion: Rescues'' 1]]</ref>}}
A '''Human''' '''male''' was on the [[Dibrook Space Station]], where he watched the reporter [[Cianba]] on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] when the space station was attacked by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik-vec assault cruiser|Yorik-Vec]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The attack tore a hole in the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and the [[Gender/Legends|man]] was blown out into [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

The [[Human/Legends|human]] wore a brown shirt, with a blue, bulky breastplate and armor covering his body. He was armed with various weapons, including a dagger.
